name: Uesugi Kenshin
source:
The Seiryu of Heaven from the realm of Ryōen

The lord of Kasugayama castle who ruled over Echigo domain.
25 years old.
A military commander and strategist who value justice and earned a title "God of War"
His appearance giving an impression of otherwordly beauty.
A worshipper of Bishamonten.

Character Designer: Bekko

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara03_uesugikenshin.html]official website[/url]]

[Spoiler]His appearance is a proof that he is a member of Oni tribe[/Spoiler]
